text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Increased 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate across us-west-2 (model: redwood/gpt-open-16k). Error pattern shows segfaults / runtime crashes (SIGSEGV) in model-runner processes. Paging @ben (oncall)

ben (oncall): seeing it, joining. How widespread? any customer-facing pages?

alice (eng-runtime): we have ~18% 5xx on the endpoint across both hosted and dedicated pools. Logs show repeated "Segmentation fault" from model-runner pid 8421 and OOM-killer dmesg lines on some hosts.

carol (sre): which hosts/instance ids? do we have a rollout or recent change?

alice (eng-runtime): affected pool: mr-pool-usw2-a (GPU 80s). Instances: mr-usw2-12, mr-usw2-17, mr-usw2-21. No recent rollout in the last 24h. config: batch_size=8, max_context=16384, model variant=quant-8.

dave (mlinfra): repro looks correlated with very long contexts (12k+ tokens) where KV cache grows and sometimes memory spikes. We're seeing the process memory jump then crash. Might be a bug in kv cache growth/resize path.

ben (oncall): customer impact? any big tenants?

elaine (customer-success): Notified two enterprise customers via PagerDuty. They're seeing request failures and slow retries. One has production traffic in us-west-2 and reported timeouts. They asked for ETA.

alice (eng-runtime): immediate mitigations I propose: 1) drain traffic from the affected pool to fallback pool (smaller instances) 2) temporarily reduce default max_context to 8k for hosted API 3) force model-runner to run with batch_size=1 for affected hosts. 4) capture core dumps and gdb bt for crashed processes.

ben (oncall): do it. Carol, can you coordinate the drain and reroute? Alice/dave, take care of crash captures. Elaine will update customers.

carol (sre): ACK. Starting drain of mr-pool-usw2-a now. I'll set maintenance on 3 instances and remove them from LB.

ops-bot: Started service drain: mr-usw2-12, mr-usw2-17, mr-usw2-21. 60s connection drain initiated.

ben (oncall): traffic reroute in place?

carol (sre): reroute to mr-pool-usw2-b (healthy). We see 3xx transient retries then success on fallback. Monitoring dashboards show 5xx dropping from 18% -> 6% after partial drain.

alice (eng-runtime): applying runtime override: set default max_context=8192 for hosted requests. Pushing config...

ops-bot: Config override applied: default.max_context=8192 for api-route /v1/generate — effective immediately.

alice (eng-runtime): also pushing per-host agent to set batch_size=1 for model-runner on the drained hosts to reduce memory pressure if they receive any stray traffic.

ben (oncall): good. Meanwhile we need artifacts: core dumps, gdb backtrace, pmap, free -m, dmesg tail for each crashed host. Dave, Alice — collect and upload to incident bucket.

dave (mlinfra): collecting now. Commands I'm running:```
sudo systemctl stop model-runner
sudo gdb -batch -ex "thread apply all bt full" -ex "quit" /opt/model-runner/bin/model-runner core.8421 > /tmp/core.8421.bt
pmap 8421 > /tmp/pmap.8421
cat /proc/8421/limits > /tmp/limits.8421
dmesg | tail -n 200 > /tmp/dmesg.tail
```
Uploading to s3://incident-artifacts/1772501234/ now.

alice (eng-runtime): early gdb backtrace shows crash in kv_cache_resize -> jemalloc -> memset. Could be a double-free or out-of-bounds write during kv buffer reallocation. Attaching snippet:```
#0  0x00007f2d0c1a6b3 in memcpy () from /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6
#1  0x00007f2d1012f4a in kv_cache_resize (cache=0x7f2c3e0) at kv_cache.c:412
#2  0x00007f2d1013a1b in kv_cache_append (cache=0x7f2c3e0, data=0x7f4b5) at kv_cache.c:521
#3  0x000055aa8f2b3c in runner_step (ctx=0x55aa8a) at runner.c:1180
```

ben (oncall): looks like runtime bug. Any quick patch?

alice (eng-runtime): short-term: we can disable KV cache growth by capping max_kv_memory to 2GB via env override and fall back to slower recomputation. That should avoid the resize path causing segfaults. I'll push as hotfix to affected pools.

alice (eng-runtime): pushing hotfix env: MODEL_KV_MAX_BYTES=2147483648 to mr-pool-usw2-a and apply to mr-pool-usw2-b as precaution.

ops-bot: Env override applied to: mr-usw2-12, mr-usw2-17, mr-usw2-21; mr-usw2-08, mr-usw2-09 (precaution). Restarting model-runner services sequentially (rolling).

carol (sre): good. Post-hotfix metrics: 5xx fell to ~2.1% across us-west-2 after drains + hotfix. Latency slightly up for long contexts as expected.

elaine (customer-success): updated customers: told them we've rerouted traffic, applied mitigations, and collecting root cause. They requested timeline for a permanent fix.

ben (oncall): next steps: 1) eng-runtime to produce minimal reproducer for kv_cache resize bug (deterministic) 2) implement regression test and patch 3) plan safe rollout to prod with canary. Also need an RCA doc once we have full root cause and fix.

alice (eng-runtime): agreeing. Already started working on small repro harness that pumps long-context requests with controlled kv sizes. Will post PR for fix and test.

dave (mlinfra): we've saved all artifacts to s3://incident-artifacts/1772501234/ (core, bt, pmap, dmesg). Also captured perf profiles for a sample run.

carol (sre): I'm handing off on-call to @carol (sre) shift lead for follow-ups — ben, I think you can sign off once customers ack?

ben (oncall): I'll stay for 30m to confirm stability then sign off. Elaine, keep customers informed about ETA for patch.

elaine (customer-success): will do. One customer wants a targeted mitigation (pin to quant-4k variant). Can we offer that?

alice (eng-runtime): yes, we can pin them to quant-4k variant and lower max_context per-tenant. I'll prepare a per-tenant override and coordinate with support runbook.

ben (oncall): great. If anything spikes again, re-open page. For now, reduced severity to P2 and continuing monitoring. Thanks all. :pray:

incident-bot: Incident status changed -> "mitigated (partial)". Links: dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/insights/incidents/1772501234, artifacts: s3://incident-artifacts/1772501234/

carol (sre): Handoff note: follow up tasks in the incident doc: - reproduce and patch KV resize - add mem limits + alerting for sudden mem growth - add canary for large-context workloads - customer pinning docs - postmortem draft. I'll create the postmortem ticket and assign owners.

ben (oncall): signing off at 1772501630. Leaving the room to carol.
